description: Phase 3 github_mcp discovery for triggerdev; captured 2026-05-15 baseline.

api_available.evidence: An SDK and docs are mentioned, but the source does not explicitly state a general public API.

auth_required.evidence: The README mentions account/project creation for the web app, but does not specify authentication requirements for the listing.

interactive_ui.evidence: The README mentions a web app, dashboard filtering, realtime updates, and trace view/monitoring UI.

local_setup_required.evidence: The README says to "write tasks in your codebase" and includes local development and self-hosting guides.

open_source.evidence: "Open Source" badge and GitHub repository are provided in the README.

read_data.evidence: The source describes task execution and monitoring, but does not clearly state a data-reading integration for an LLM assistant.

remote_available.evidence: The README says tasks automatically scale and connect to "our cloud" and also mentions a web app and cloud onboarding.

write_actions.evidence: The source describes running tasks and bulk actions on runs, but not a specific assistant-facing write action integration.

expected_sanitized_draft.long_description: Trigger.dev is an open-source platform for building AI workflows in TypeScript. It supports durable long-running tasks, retries, queues, observability, real-time updates, human-in-the-loop waits, and self-hosting.
expected_sanitized_draft.name: Trigger.dev
expected_sanitized_draft.proposed_verdict: Trigger.dev is an open-source platform for building and deploying AI workflows and agents in TypeScript, aimed at developers who need durable background execution, retries, queues, and observability. The main trade-off is that it is a developer platform rather than a turnkey assistant app, so it fits teams willing to work in code or self-host.
expected_sanitized_draft.scope_summary: Open-source TypeScript platform for AI workflows and agents with durable task execution, realtime updates, human-in-the-loop waits, observability, and self-hosting.
expected_sanitized_draft.short_description: Open-source platform for building and deploying AI workflows and agents in TypeScript, with durable long-running tasks, retries, queues, observability, and self-hosting options.
